records.name: Create Invoice(s)
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <group>
                    <field name="count"/>
                    <field name="consolidated_billing" invisible="count == 1"/>
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button name="action_create_invoices" type="object" string="Create" class="btn-primary" data-hotkey="q"/>
                    <button string="Cancel" class="btn-secondary" special="cancel" data-hotkey="x"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
